chapters.title: Introduction and the guest's path into data and AI

takeaways: Trusted enterprise AI starts with the right use case and good-quality, well-structured data, not with the latest large language model.
Microsoft Foundry bundles a model catalog, agents, guardrails, evaluation and observability in one enterprise AI platform.
Define an acceptable baseline, test negative scenarios, keep a human in the loop and build governance into the architecture from the start.
hook: Many organizations want AI, but few turn it into trusted business value. In this interview, Microsoft MVP Shubhangi Goyal explains for data, AI and IT leaders why good AI starts with good data. You will hear how Microsoft Foundry, guardrails, evaluations and governance by design help you build reliable enterprise agents and measure their ROI.
